data.one_liner: Detect phone shake gestures with pause/resume and optional widget wrapper
data.what_it_does: The package listens to device sensors to detect shake gestures and exposes callbacks. It can be used as a widget wrapper or a listener class, with automatic pause/resume when the app goes to background or foreground.
use_when: Need shake gesture detection in a Flutter app
Want automatic pause/resume when app backgrounded
Prefer a simple widget wrapper for UI integration
avoid_when: You need custom shake sensitivity or advanced motion analysis
You already have a custom sensor listener implementation
strengths: Easy to integrate via widget or listener
No extra build_runner or codegen required
weaknesses: Only supports sensors_plus; no custom sensitivity settings documented
Limited to shake detection, no other motion gestures
